p9.title: AFTER-CALL WORK
p9.action: The status flips from AVAILABLE to AFTER-CALL WORK. Lia's hand leaves the mouse and reaches for the phone face-up beside the keyboard. The ghost drifts a little closer to the desk.
p9.camera: Medium over the desk, same crop as the end of the call
p9.note: v0.3 Scene 9: after the call, her status changes to AFTER-CALL WORK. She reaches for her phone.

p9.title: The message is still there
p9.monitor:
Mama ❤️
Earlier tonight
Nak, nakapadala na ka?
Bisan Friday na lang. Amping.
p9.action: Phone close-up fills the right half of the frame. The thread with Mama ❤️ shows the two messages from the first visit, unanswered since 2:07. Her thumb hovers.
p9.camera: Phone crop; her face stays at the left edge
p9.note: Same Cebuano drafts as the first visit (source Tagalog: Nak, nakapagpadala ka na ba? / Kahit Friday na lang. Ingat ka diyan).

p9.title: She types
p9.monitor:
Ma, Friday pa akong sweldo. Padala ko after.
Nikaon na pud ko hehe
p9.action: Two bubbles appear on her side with a 0.6 s gap: 'Ma, Friday pa akong sweldo. Padala ko after.' then 'Nikaon na pud ko hehe'. Gloss under the phone: Ma, payday is Friday. I'll send after. / I've eaten too hehe.
p9.note: Cebuano drafts of v0.3: Ma, Friday pa sweldo ko. Padala ako after. / Kumain na rin ako hehe. Carl to tune.

p9.title: A photo of the container
p9.action: She lifts the phone over the desk; a camera frame appears over the almost-empty adobo container, rice grains and the spoon. Shutter.
p9.camera: Medium; the camera frame drawn over the desk
p9.note: v0.3: She takes a photograph of her almost-empty adobo container.

p9.title: Naay gulay. Technically.
p9.action: Her spoon tips the bay leaf into view inside the camera frame. Balloon above her. Small smile, no laugh.
p9.note: Cebuano draft of v0.3 May gulay. Technically. Gloss: It has vegetables. Technically.

p9.title: Sent
p9.monitor:
[photo: adobo container, one bay leaf]
Sent 2:3x AM
p9.action: The photo bubble lands in the thread. Delivered tick.

p9.title: Her mother's earlier line
p9.monitor: MAMA: Ayaw pasagdi imong kaugalingon, nak.
p9.action: The thread scrolls so Mama's earlier line sits above the photo. Lia reads it and does not type. Gloss: Take care of yourself, child. Hold.
p9.camera: Phone crop, then a slow pull back toward medium
p9.note: Cebuano draft of v0.3 Huwag mong pabayaan sarili mo, anak. v0.3: Lia doesn't respond immediately.

p9.title: The budget note
p9.monitor:
RENT · KURYENTE · GROCERY
TRANSPO (onsite days)
PADALA SA BALAY: Friday
p9.action: Observe on the desk: a small handwritten note beside the phone. Ordinary lines: rent, electricity, groceries, transport for onsite days, the planned transfer home. No close-up of a wallet, no music cue.
p9.camera: Close on the note, the phone still in frame
p9.note: v0.3: a small budgeting note; no sad orchestral cue; no close-up of a nearly empty wallet.

p9.title: The same lean, eyes closed
p9.action: Lia leans back in the chair exactly as she did after the knockout replay (same angle, same arms), but this time she closes her eyes. The ghost floats beside the chair. Nothing else moves.
p9.camera: Wide; hold 3 s; identical framing to the first visit's lean-back card
p9.note: v0.3 recurring visual gesture: the victory lean from Scene 4 repeated after the call; the meaning has changed. Prioritised above almost everything else.

k10.title: buhi pa ka?
k10.monitor:
MIKA: buhi pa ka?
LIA: unfortunately
k10.action: A new thread lights up: Mika. Her reply is instant. Two-person composition: the phone and Lia's face share the frame.
k10.note: Cebuano draft of v0.3 MIKA: buhay ka pa? (you still alive?). Her 'unfortunately' is English in the source.

k10.title: movie later?
k10.monitor:
MIKA: movie later? you bailed last time
LIA: after shift promise
MIKA: that's what you said last time
k10.action: Three bubbles in turn, 0.7 s apart. Lia's typing is quick; Mika's last line lands and she stops.

k10.title: Types, deletes, types again
k10.action: A typing indicator starts, the draft 'i was' appears, is deleted character by character, then the cursor blinks alone for 1 s.
k10.note: v0.3: Lia starts typing. Deletes it. Types again.

k10.title: farming wins
k10.monitor:
LIA: okay fine i was farming wins 😭
MIKA: farming enemies more like
LIA: character development
MIKA: yours or theirs?
k10.action: Four bubbles, 0.7 s apart. On the last one Lia laughs once, shoulders bounce, the ghost's ears lift slightly.

k10.title: At least sa game
k10.speech: At least sa game, kabalo ko nga maayo ko.
k10.action: She goes quiet. The line is said to herself, small balloon, no portrait, eyes on the dark phone. Gloss under the balloon: At least in the game, I know I'm good at something. Hold.
k10.note: Cebuano draft of v0.3 At least sa game, alam kong magaling ako. Deliberately understated: not a speech to the player.

k10.title: Back to the queue
k10.action: She checks the clock, puts the phone face-down, and clicks AVAILABLE. Her next break is a long way off.
k10.note: v0.3: She checks the time. Her next break isn't for a while. She returns to the work application.

t11.title: 2:48 AM
t11.action: Wide room. A call connects; she answers in work voice (no balloon, murmur only). The player can float the ghost anywhere during this scene; the room keeps changing behind it.
t11.camera: Wide, fixed; the player moves inside it
t11.note: v0.3 Scene 11: a compressed sequence of Lia's night passes while the player moves the ghost.

t11.title: 3:19 AM
t11.action: Same framing. She takes a sip of lukewarm coffee and grimaces slightly; the mug goes back beside the keyboard.
t11.note: v0.3: She takes a sip of lukewarm coffee.

t11.title: 3:52 AM
t11.action: She stretches her shoulders, arms up, and looks at the clock on the work app. Returns to the keyboard.
t11.note: v0.3: She stretches her shoulders and checks the clock.

t11.title: 4:17 AM, BREAK
t11.action: Status flips to BREAK. She removes the headset and hangs it on the hook. The room becomes quiet: the call murmur stops, only the fan.
t11.sound: Headset click on the hook; murmur stops
t11.note: v0.3: Her status changes. BREAK. She removes her headset. The room becomes quiet.

t11.title: Usa pa.
t11.action: She opens the fighting game. The familiar music starts faintly from the monitor. Balloon: Usa pa. Gloss: One more.
t11.camera: Medium on her and the monitor
t11.sound: Arena music, faint, from the monitor speaker
t11.note: Cebuano draft of v0.3 Isa pa. (One more.)

t11.title: Toward the light
t11.action: The ghost turns to the monitor. The screen begins to glow white. For the first time the ghost does not brace or flinch; it floats toward the light on its own, tail last. Cut to the arena.
t11.note: v0.3: For the first time, the ghost doesn't look terrified of being pulled back. It floats toward the light.

f12.title: CONNECTION: STABLE
f12.action: The arena loads with the same music. Two lines in the top band, the second one new: CONNECTION: STABLE. No explanation offered.
f12.note: v0.3 Scene 12: we don't explain the improved connection as a reward. The supernatural connection has stabilized. That's all.

f12.title: Your block works
f12.action: Her spell comes; the player presses block and the guard appears on the same frame. The spell breaks on it. The wolf is not pushed.
f12.control: Full control from here; inputs respond immediately
f12.note: v0.3: your attacks respond immediately. You can actually defend yourself.

f12.title: Exchange one
f12.action: Lia catches one of your dodges with the cyan spell; you land a strong crescent counter that pushes her back to the left edge. Both health bars drop.
f12.note: v0.3 middle exchange: Lia catches one of your dodges, but you land a strong counterattack.

f12.title: Exchange two
f12.action: Both fighters damaged; she is still genuinely skilled. Neither is guaranteed the win. The match continues under player control.
f12.note: v0.3: Neither fighter is guaranteed victory. Winning is independent of empathy.

f12.title: Final stock
f12.action: The last hit lands one way or the other. For a fraction of a second the game is silent.
f12.note: v0.3: For a fraction of a second, the game is silent.

f12.title: ALTERNATIVE A: VICTORY
f12.chat:
lia_ph: ez
lia_ph: for you apparently 💀
f12.action: VICTORY drops in. Lia types ez, then a second message 0.8 s later: for you apparently 💀. She is being sarcastic about her own loss.

f12.title: ALTERNATIVE B: DEFEAT
f12.action: DEFEAT drops in. lia_ph: ez. No apology. No sudden friendship. Just Lia.

f12.title: We stay in the game
f12.action: No cut to her room. The result fades; her username stays on the dark arena. The player has to remember the person behind it themselves.
f12.sound: Music fades to a low hum
f12.note: v0.3 important camera decision: we don't cut to Lia's bedroom after the fight.

e13.title: Only the chat remains
e13.action: The HUD disappears. Only MATCH CHAT remains over black, with the 00:03 timer. The same two buttons, same crop, same scale as Scene 2: okay that was clean / fuck off. Nothing marks either one.
e13.camera: Same chat crop as Scene 2 frame 2.07 and the second match
e13.control: One tap, or let the clock expire
e13.note: v0.3 Scene 13: the same two replies appear. Three seconds. Carl: identical pair at opening and end, the before-and-after measure.

e13.title: ENDING A: give her credit
e13.chat:
you: okay that was clean
lia_ph: gg
e13.action: Your line, then after 0.8 s her reply: gg. Nothing else. No friendship reward, no thank you.
e13.note: Her reply gg is from the short adaptation (BETWEEN_ROUNDS); v0.3 gives no closing reply text. Carl to confirm.

e13.title: ENDING B: lash out
e13.chat:
you: fuck off
(lia_ph closed the chat)
e13.action: Your line lands on her screen. After 1 s the chat closes from her side. No breakdown, no punishment.
e13.note: From the short adaptation: she closes chat. The message was small on your screen too.

e13.title: ENDING C: nothing sent
e13.chat:
00:03 · 00:02 · 00:01
(reply box gone)
lia_ph requested a rematch
e13.action: The clock runs out. The reply box disappears. The rematch invitation stays on screen, unanswered. Give it an unhurried beat.
e13.note: v0.3 Ending C, Nothing Sent. The short adaptation: a meaningful boundary, not a failed good ending.

e13.title: 4:25 AM, Good morning
e13.action: Cut back to the room in the exact wide composition of the first visit. The fan still rattles. The rice container is still on the desk. Lia stretches, looks at the time, sighs.
e13.camera: Wide, identical to the first visit
e13.note: v0.3 final cinematic: the same wide composition from our first visit.

e13.title: BREAK ENDS IN 00:15
e13.action: A work notification. She puts the headset back on.

e13.title: It was sent
e13.action: She opens her mother's chat and checks whether her message went through. The two ticks are there. She closes the phone.
e13.note: v0.3: She opens her mother's chat and checks whether her message was sent. It was.

e13.title: Okay. Kaya pa.
e13.action: She adjusts the headset and says it to no one. Gloss: Okay. I can do this. Then she clicks AVAILABLE.
e13.note: v0.3 line kept as is; it reads the same in Cebuano.

e13.title: Thank you for calling
e13.speech: Thank you for calling. My name is Lia. How may I help you?
e13.action: The camera stays on the room as she takes the next call. Her voice is professional again. Fade to black before we hear the customer.
e13.camera: Wide; fade out on the line
e13.note: v0.3: We fade before hearing the customer's response.

e13.title: Your side
e13.action: Return to the player's original setup: the monitor is cracked, the game is still visible behind the crack, a small chat window sits in the corner. For a moment nothing moves. Cut to black.
e13.note: v0.3: the monitor is cracked, but the game is still visible. A small chat window sits in the corner.

e13.overlay:
